label: IDAES High-Effectiveness NTU Heat Exchanger
request: Build and solve a single IDAES HeatExchangerNTU using aqueous MEA/CO2/H2O streams. Use 140 m2 area, 250 W/m2/K heat-transfer coefficient, 0.85 effectiveness, and 3000 Pa pressure drop on each side; report both outlet temperatures and compositions.
